image_description: A close-up studio shot of a silver wire-wrapped necklace featuring purple gemstones (likely amethyst) and small pearls. The necklace has a complex, handcrafted pendant with coiled wire details and dangling beads. It rests on a plain white background. A watermark text 'Asla Romkaitė' is visible in the bottom right corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Decorative chain or cord of substantial length, draping gracefully around the neck and resting on the upper chest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows a long chain arranged in a loop, consistent with how a necklace would drape, although it is laid flat rather than worn on a person.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fine metal chains with interlocking links or beaded strands.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The chain consists of clear, interlocking oval metal links.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pendant necklaces have central decorative element hanging from chain.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a large, intricate wire-wrapped centerpiece containing purple stones.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Clasp mechanism visible at back for fastening.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A lobster claw clasp and jump ring are clearly visible at the top right of the chain loop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Individual link patterns visible (cable, curb, box, or rope style).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The individual oval links of the cable-style chain are distinct and sharp.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beaded strands feature spherical, faceted, or irregular gemstones or pearls.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pendant features faceted purple gemstones and small spherical pearls/beads integrated into the wirework.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gold, silver, or platinum metal chains with reflective polished surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The metal exhibits high reflectivity and specular highlights consistent with polished silver or white gold.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Leather cords or woven threads as alternative materials.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The item is constructed entirely of metal wire and chain; no leather or thread is present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Decorative jewelry worn around the neck.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly identifiable as decorative jewelry intended for the neck.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomy of the jewelry (e.g., distinguishing wire-wrapped artisan jewelry from mass-produced stamped metal) and verify class alignment.
Wire-wrapped jewelry is prone to AI artifacts where wires fuse into gems or background. This expert will check for continuous, non-melted wire paths.
To ensure the faceted gems have correct internal refraction and sit physically within the wire settings rather than floating or merging.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the signature text in the bottom right corner.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and noise levels typical of macro photography.

focus_areas: Continuity of thin wire coils in the pendant
Refraction and facet definition of purple gemstones
Sharpness of chain links against the white background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the wire-wrapping logic. In AI images, thin wires often disappear into the background or merge illogically with the stones they are supposed to hold. Verify if the clasp mechanism looks mechanically functional or just vaguely 'clasp-like'.
